title: SB027 · The night watch (source scene 21–22)
subtitle: Silent · emotion Quiet · three shots, 8 s each · the uru at sea, late at night · Ranjith, 2026-11-07

panels.title: The sleeping deck
beats: Looking aft: the deckhouse windows glow from the lantern inside; the wheel is seen through them.
0–2 s still: Raghavan, Babu and Sasi asleep on the mats; Aashaan at the wheel inside.
2–6 s Babu turns over; Aashaan eases the wheel; lantern light swings.

panels.title: Aashaan at the wheel inside
beats: Inside the deckhouse from behind his right shoulder, looking out through the windows to the bow.
0–2 s steering, eyes on the sea; Antony small at the bow through the window.
2–6 s a quarter turn and back; a glance at the compass, then out to the bow.

panels.title: Antony keeps watch forward
beats: Looking forward over the bow: stem post, bitts, coiled rope, moon high on the right.
0–2 s Antony at the rail, back three-quarters to us, looking out.
2–6 s rubs his neck, leans on the rail, scans the water left to right.
6–8 s still, eyes on the horizon, hold. Leads into SB028 (a distant light).
